title: Setting band combinations, feature set combinations and feature sets supported by the UE

entities.name: UE Capability Reporting Procedure
entities.description: Procedure invoked by UE when network requests UE capabilities for NR, E-UTRA-NR, or E-UTRA. The UE processes candidate band combinations and feature sets based on network requests and filters.

entities.name: UE-NR-Capability
entities.description: Container for NR capabilities including supported band combinations and feature sets.

entities.name: UE-MRDC-Capability
entities.description: Container for Multi-Radio Dual Connectivity capabilities including feature set combinations.

entities.name: UE-EUTRA-Capability
entities.description: Container for E-UTRA capabilities including feature sets for E-UTRA.

entities.name: supportedBandCombinationList
entities.description: List of supported NR-only band combinations included in UE-NR-Capability.

entities.name: featureSetCombinations
entities.description: Feature set combinations referenced from supported band combinations.

entities.name: featureSets
entities.description: NR feature sets referenced from candidate feature set combinations.

entities.name: featureSetsEUTRA
entities.description: E-UTRA feature sets included in UE-EUTRA-Capability.

entities.name: frequencyBandListFilter
entities.description: Filter provided by network to select band combinations.

entities.name: eutra-nr-only flag
entities.description: Flag indicating UE shall not include NR-only band combinations when E-UTRA network requests capabilities.

entities.name: rat-Type nr
entities.description: Condition when requested RAT type is NR.

entities.name: rat-Type eutra-nr
entities.description: Condition when requested RAT type is E-UTRA-NR.

entities.name: rat-Type eutra
entities.description: Condition when requested RAT type is E-UTRA.

entities.name: srs-SwitchingTimesList
entities.description: SRS carrier switching times included for band combinations when SRS carrier switching is supported.

relations.description: Procedure populates UE-NR-Capability container with NR capabilities.
Procedure populates UE-MRDC-Capability container with feature set combinations.
Procedure populates UE-EUTRA-Capability container with E-UTRA feature sets.
eutra-nr-only flag condition affects which band combinations are included in supportedBandCombinationList.
rat-Type nr condition determines inclusion of NR-only band combinations.
rat-Type eutra-nr condition determines inclusion of E-UTRA-NR band combinations.
rat-Type eutra condition determines inclusion of E-UTRA feature sets.
supportedBandCombinationList includes srs-SwitchingTimesList when SRS carrier switching is supported.
Procedure includes received frequencyBandListFilter in appliedFreqBandListFilter field.
